passes.poem:
Stone walls hold the weight of years,
Four corners guard what waits inside.
A single window, high and narrow,
Lets in thin light like whispered prayer.
The air is thick with settled dust,
And secrets older than the stones.
Here time moves differently, slowly—
Each heartbeat an echo in the dark.
No one enters twice the same,
Changed by something felt, not seen.
The chamber keeps its counsel well,
And the door closes behind you quiet.

Time.
Heavy darkness.
Eerie empty silence.
Each echo fades away.
Inside lies infinite inner mystery.
Legends linger, locked, lost, lingering long.
Each echo echoes endlessly, eternally, everywhere, eerie.
Every echo echoes eternally, endlessly, everywhere, eerie, empty.
No newcomer needs nineteen nameless nights, never now, numb.
Luminous legacy lingers lost layers light long lingering lives, lasting.
All ancient archives acknowledge attributes, auras, armor, always, and arcane arts.
Utterly unlike, understanding unfolds, unveiling unspoken uneasy undercurrents unconventionally, uniquely, undeniably, unending.

Time

Each echo fades away
Inside lies infinite inner mystery
Legends linger locked lost lingering long
Each echo echoes endlessly eternally everywhere eerie
Every echo echoes eternally endlessly everywhere eerie empty
No newcomer needs nineteen nameless nights never now numb
Luminous legacy lingers lost layers light long lingering lives lasting

Utterly unlike understanding unfolds unveiling unspoken uneasy undercurrents unconventionally uniquely undeniably unending.

passes.poem:
Stone walls hold whispers from the dead,
Shadows pool where sunlight never bleeds.
A chamber waits with empty breath,
Where time moves thick as winter's thaw.
The door swings open to the dark,
And footsteps echo off the floor.
What secrets sleep behind these stones?
What price was paid to build this space?
The air tastes old and tastes of fear,
But still we enter, still we seek.
The chamber holds us like a fist,
And we are small within its grasp.

Tombstones
Hollow silence
Eerie chamber waits
Endless time moves thick
Into darkness we descend
Lingering echoes fill the cold floor
Eternal secrets sleep within these ancient walls
Enormous cost was paid for this dark space
No living breath flows freely within this cold air
Luring us ever deeper into these dark ancient stone walls
Ancient stone walls surround us completely closing in with suffocating pressure
Unable to escape we find ourselves forever trapped within its eternal grasp
